Name: Fill The Pond
Author: tikamin557
Description:
With just this one mod, you can hide (fill in and make arable) the ponds on each farm individually.
From small ponds to oversized ponds.

Please change the settings in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url].
The default setting is "false" for all.

It also supports ponds adjacent to walls on some farm maps.
(Wilderness Four Corners, etc.)

The setting to hide the ponds in the custom farm map, i.e., add compatibility, can be added with a simple task, so if you need it, please send a request on the POSTS page.

[color=#00ff00][size=3]The following mods currently have added compatibility:[/size][/color]
[size=4]・ Grandpa's Farm ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url])[/size]
[size=4]・ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13187]Alvadea's Farm Maps - Goldrush[/url][/size]


Currently, English (default) and Japanese translation files are included.


Also, if you want to hide the pond with this mod and place a pond of any size in any position you want, we recommend using the following mod.
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25528]Pond Added To Farm[/url][/size]
